purpose: A finite from-scratch official-code BONES run with paper-informed all-Adam and cosine learning rates; evaluate the complete selected schedule, not another warm-start optimizer ablation.

claim_scope.paper_collection_iteration_mapping: Explicit implementation choice following the public current and pre-Muon official runner loop. The exact paper-run scheduler implementation was not recovered.

source.statistics_patch_application: In a clean abc124c isolated tree apply scripts/o3/official_diagnostics.patch once and scripts/o5/official_optimizer_modes.patch once; if reusing already patched files do not apply again. Preserve self.o3_diagnostics and all historical source trees.
source.configuration_reference_role: reuse the actual non-optimizer algorithm/environment/data settings, not weights or normalization state
source.launcher_consistency: Deploy scripts/o6 under workspace/work/o6; shell driver path, cwd, PYTHONPATH and actual import source all resolve O6. Never run work/o5/driver.py under an O6 label.

initialization.data_lineage_source: Read the existing packed motion manifest directly; do not load a parent checkpoint for data_lineage.

training.lr_schedule: cosine to 0.03 times initial LR over 250000 completed collection iterations, then constant floor until 320000
training.optimizer: Adam for all WM/Actor/Critic trainable parameters; explicit weight_decay=0
training.wm_window_semantics: Keep official cfg.wm.horizon=8 and its existing actions.shape[1]-1 rollout; do not silently change to9 to match the paper k=8 notation.

learning_rate.clock: c = number of completed collection calls in this fresh run; c=step+1 for the public zero-based runner loop
learning_rate.apply_when: After each self.step() increments completed collections, and before any joint learner update at that collection.
learning_rate.metadata: Record actual optimizer group LR from the running learner, with collection and actual joint counters, in ordinary logs and at every saved milestone. No separate scheduler probe or extra training update.

budget.interruption_handling: Record the true interrupted/failed training status and score actual saved nodes after child exit. Do not recreate replay or reset the LR clock to manufacture an uninterrupted run.
budget.normal_completion_condition: The child exits normally after exactly 320000 completed collection calls; use actual collection counter and a collection-budget stop reason. Expected joint count is not a hard completion gate.
budget.completion_logic_migration: Update trainer, common.training_state, publisher, summary/index/handoff together. O5 classifies collection_iteration_limit as interrupted; O6 must classify its intended collection-limit exit as completed and keep scoring state separate.

required_adapter_changes: Create isolated O6 user/source trees, preserve existing changes, environments and historical trees; reuse existing installed Python, assets, packed BONES and LAFAN data.
Retain O5 all-Adam construction and O3 detached diagnostics; remove mandatory parent bundle/normalizer loads and instantiate fresh WM/Actor/Critic/normalizers.

Construct all Adam device LR tensors before CUDA graph capture; update those same objects in place by completed collection clock before learning. Read actual effective group LR in ordinary runtime logs.

Replace the O5 two-arm/joint-budget driver and publisher assumptions with one O6 run and a 320000 completed-collection budget. Explicitly set max_iterations=320000; remove old 32000-joint and wall-hour stops.
Name formal milestones by collection count and publish actual joint/transitions/optimizer-step counts. Do not relabel collection 80000 as exactly joint32000.
Remove O5 historical CPU checkpoint-norm rereads, initial parent-score dependencies, same-parent gain/loss labels and between-arm expectations. Reuse published historical evidence.
Use O6 campaign/source/version fields in saved nodes, workers, summary, handoff, README and results index; include the actual scheduler and optimizer patches/adapters in the lightweight publisher.
After child exit, use one BONES worker for all actual formal nodes, then one LAFAN worker. Only resume a failed scoring/publication stage when needed; never rerun completed training for publication.
Unify deployment under workspace/work/o6 and update launcher command/cwd/PYTHONPATH/import path so no O5 adapter or source is invoked accidentally.
Set wandb_run_path=None; remove parent data_lineage/lineage counters and initial-parent score logic. Read lineage from the existing packed manifest without loading old weights.
Update completion status in every trainer/common/publisher layer to the actual collection budget, not O5 new_joint_update_limit or an expected joint count.
Add the four pre-frozen quality time series only by retaining existing tensors in the same scheduled O6 formal evaluations; no extra physics/model calls or old-checkpoint reruns.

concurrency.preferred_mode: one meaningful fresh recipe run; CPU reads/summaries may run in parallel
concurrency.resource_fallback: Keep 4096 envs and original batches. Wait for usable existing resources when necessary; do not stop unrelated tasks, resize the experiment or run a capacity benchmark.
concurrency.reason_for_one_training_process: The selected question is whether this finite paper-informed training path works. A second fixed-LR fresh run would add a new causal-ablation question and double the training budget.
parallel_cpu_tasks: Read only publicly available author run/configuration and exact motion-membership/filter sources, compare with existing project manifest, and record unresolved provenance without blocking O6.

Read existing raw scores/trajectories for the four frozen completed-but-quality-regressed/stable/long-motion examples; if raw trajectories are absent, record absence rather than rerun old checkpoints.
parallel_cpu_evidence_rules: No deletion of 880 clips to match 129514
Do not treat demo checkpoints as paper main-result checkpoints
Missing originals are recorded as evidence gaps and do not block the defined O6 run

evaluation.normalized_return: per-clip undiscounted native reward sum / (0.1*(reference_frames-1)); failure tail zero; clip macro mean
common_complete_comparisons: each O6 node vs O3 quarter16k quality reference
O6 final vs O5 muon_wd0 +32k and adam_wd0 +32k
fixed intersection of all actual O6 nodes
evaluation.gain_loss_term: historical-reference success overlap, not parent retention or forgetting
evaluation.primary_decision: Full-library return/coverage together with common-complete R/XY/body orientation and the final floor-phase trend; do not select on failure count alone.
evaluation.lafan_claim: cross-library evaluation after BONES-only training; not O1 forgetting or proven unseen generalization
evaluation.after_interrupted_training: Only after child exited, score actual saved valid nodes and existing abnormal final; missing final is not fabricated. Do not require exit_code==0 to score already saved nodes.
evaluation.quality_series_plan: fixed_quality_timeseries in this protocol; all four members frozen before O6 starts

fields: raw/clamped critic values and GAE targets/clamp fractions
completed collection / actual joint / transitions / WM Actor Critic optimizer steps
actual three-optimizer device LR at the same clock

optimizer_metadata.nodes: initial and each unique fixed/actual-final checkpoint
optimizer_metadata.serialize_only: scalar hyperparameters plus parameter names/shapes/counts; never tensors or optimizer state

diagnostics.normalizers_initialization: Fresh; no ancestor normalizer counts or state loaded.

final_failure_windows.purpose: Retain compact, correctly labelled final failure evidence. Anchor body is pelvis; anchor_pos is z-only. Raw post-step states/advanced reference and native manager termination are distinct measurement paths/times, so do not reclassify failures from the last saved raw frame.

protected: all O3 nodes including quarter16k quality anchor and quarter32k coverage anchor
O1/P6 prior acceptance and all historical protected artifacts
all O4 fixed/actual-final checkpoints, including +16k coverage reference and failed long-run endpoints
all O5 initial/fixed/final checkpoints and optimizer/normalizer metadata; specifically Muon WD0 +32k 50-failure anchor and Adam WD0 +16k/+32k references
all O6 fixed/actual-final and evaluation-referenced checkpoints

remaining_paper_differences: GenCoord vs MaxCoord main-run attribution unresolved
current source includes later architecture/runtime changes
official wm.horizon8 means eight stored states and seven supervised transitions; paper Eq1 k8 is not silently substituted
existing GenCoord real biased joint observations vs imagined no-bias observations are retained and not attributed as a proven late-regression cause
single current device vs paper H100 conditions

fixed_quality_timeseries.capture_at: All actual scheduled O6 formal BONES scoring nodes, during their existing physical scoring rollout only.
fields_from_existing_tensors: existing robot_anchor_pos_w and reference anchor_pos_w with env_origin recorded
fixed_quality_timeseries.timing: Preserve native reward/termination timing. Quality uses existing post-step refreshed state and advanced reference. Record which frame/time each array represents; no reclassification of failures from raw final errors.
fixed_quality_timeseries.when_member_fails_in_O6: Keep the same member and record its actual executed prefix and terminal sample. Do not substitute a newly successful clip, pad, or rerun.
fixed_quality_timeseries.storage: Cache only selected small tensors on device, transfer after the scoring batch, and save compact per-node NPZ plus field/units/timing/source/env_origin schema. Include these evidence files in lightweight Git publication.
fixed_quality_timeseries.formal_return_unchanged: Formal R uses the existing cumulative reward over every scored physical transition, never an approximation from the stride5 diagnostic samples.
